Definition: Eden, the region of Adam's home
BiblicalUsage: Eden= "pleasure"; n pr m loc; 1) the first habitat of man after the creation; site unknown; n pr m; 2) a Gershonite Levite, son of Joah in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah
